title: Understanding Stocks and Equities
content: A stock (also known as equity or share) represents fractional ownership in a corporation. When you buy a company's stock, you become a shareholder and own a tiny piece of that company's assets and earnings. Investors return money from stocks through capital appreciation (when stock price increases) and dividend payments (payouts of company profits). Stocks carry higher market risk compared to fixed income, but historically offer higher long-term inflation-beating returns.
